characters.name: ORAV OTT
characters.description: Väike oranž orav koheva triibulise sabaga, kandmas rohelist kootud kampsunit, peas pole mütsi ega kapuutsi, suured rõõmsad silmad ja sõbralik naeratus. Armas multifilmistiil.

characters.name: SIIL SASS
characters.description: Väike hall siil pehmete okastega, kaelas kollane sall, muid riideid pole, uudishimulikud silmad ja naeratav nägu. Armas multifilmistiil.

locations.name: Sügisene park künkal
locations.description: Autumn park on a grassy hill with colorful orange and yellow oak trees in the background, a small wooden bench on the left side, clear blue sky with a gentle breeze, bright autumn light. Cartoon style.

pages.text: ORAV OTT JA SIIL SASS LÄHEVAD ÕUE.
pages.scene: Orav Ott in a green knitted sweater and Siil Sass in a yellow scarf stand together on a grassy autumn hill. Colorful red and orange trees are in the background, with a small wooden bench on the left side. Blue sky above. Both look happy and excited. Orav Ott always wears his green knitted sweater and nothing on his head (no hat, no hood). Siil Sass wears only his yellow scarf; his arms are bare grey fur with no sleeves or sweater. The grassy hill fills the picture down to the bottom edge. Landscape composition.

On the same autumn hill, colourful autumn leaves are blowing through the air in the wind. Orav Ott and Siil Sass stand together, as the wind gently blows Sass's yellow scarf and ruffles Ott's fur. The bright blue sky has light windy swirls. Orav Ott always wears his green knitted sweater and nothing on his head (no hat, no hood). Siil Sass wears only his yellow scarf; his arms are bare grey fur with no sleeves or sweater. The grassy hill fills the picture down to the bottom edge. Landscape composition.

Orav Ott stands on the grassy hill holding a bright diamond-shaped red kite with long colorful ribbons. Siil Sass stands beside Ott, pointing at the kite with a delighted expression. The background shows the same autumn hill with colorful trees and yellow wooden bench. Orav Ott always wears his green knitted sweater and nothing on his head (no hat, no hood). Siil Sass wears only his yellow scarf; his arms are bare grey fur with no sleeves or sweater. The grassy hill fills the picture down to the bottom edge. Landscape composition.

Siil Sass holds a roll of thick bright yellow string tightly with both hands, standing on the grassy hill. Orav Ott stands nearby holding the red kite above his head with both paws, ready to let it go. The kite is still in Ott's paws, not yet flying. Autumn background with trees and blue sky. Orav Ott always wears his green knitted sweater and nothing on his head (no hat, no hood). Siil Sass wears only his yellow scarf; his arms are bare grey fur with no sleeves or sweater. The grassy hill fills the picture down to the bottom edge. Landscape composition.

The diamond-shaped red kite flies up into the bright blue sky. Siil Sass stands on the grassy hill below holding the yellow string, looking up in awe. Orav Ott raises his hands in excitement. Trees with orange leaves frame the hill. Orav Ott always wears his green knitted sweater and nothing on his head (no hat, no hood). Siil Sass wears only his yellow scarf; his arms are bare grey fur with no sleeves or sweater. The grassy hill fills the picture down to the bottom edge. Landscape composition.

High in the bright blue sky, the red kite with fluttering ribbons dances gracefully in the wind. Below on the grassy hill, small figures of Orav Ott and Siil Sass can be seen looking up happily, holding the yellow string. Colorful autumn trees around the hill. Orav Ott always wears his green knitted sweater and nothing on his head (no hat, no hood). Siil Sass wears only his yellow scarf; his arms are bare grey fur with no sleeves or sweater. The grassy hill fills the picture down to the bottom edge. Landscape composition.

Orav Ott and Siil Sass stand side by side on the grassy hill, both holding the yellow string together and looking up smiling at the red kite floating high in the sky. Warm autumn sunlight glows on the trees and grass. Orav Ott always wears his green knitted sweater and nothing on his head (no hat, no hood). Siil Sass wears only his yellow scarf; his arms are bare grey fur with no sleeves or sweater. The grassy hill fills the picture down to the bottom edge. Landscape composition.

pages.text: OTT JA SASS ON VÄGA ÕNNELIKUD.
pages.scene: Orav Ott and Siil Sass jump happily on the grassy hill, cheering and clapping. The red kite flies steadily in the blue sky above them, and Sass still holds its yellow string in one paw. The colorful autumn leaves create a bright frame. Both characters have big joyful smiles. Orav Ott always wears his green knitted sweater and nothing on his head (no hat, no hood). Siil Sass wears only his yellow scarf; his arms are bare grey fur with no sleeves or sweater. The grassy hill fills the picture down to the bottom edge. Landscape composition.
